heading: Marriages to be solemnized according to Act
title: Marriages to be solemnized according to Act
text: Every marriage between persons, one or both of whom is or are a Christian or Christians, shall be solemnized in accordance with the provisions of the next following section; and any such marriage solemnized otherwise than in accordance with such provisions shall be void.

heading: Divorce Act 1869: When husband or wife may petition for dissolution
title: Divorce Act 1869: When husband or wife may petition for dissolution
text: Any husband may present a petition to the Family Court or District Court praying that his marriage may be dissolved on the ground that his wife has been guilty of adultery. Any wife may present a petition praying that her marriage may be dissolved on the ground that her husband has been guilty of incestuous adultery, bigamy with adultery, rape, sodomy, bestiality, or adultery coupled with cruelty or desertion without reasonable excuse for two years or upwards.
